count_reconciliation: 54 raw record-time cases reproduce the score/window rule. Of these, 53 have onset>=32s; Robbery105 has onset 31.333s and only 29.333s maximum alarm lead. Two further mixed-anomaly cases fail clear-history eligibility. All 54 are retained and reviewed; 51 are VA30 eligible30. This is distinct from the existing aggression_level>=.8 all-event audit (51 candidates, 27 clear-window cases).
interpretation_limits: Model-selected, nonrepresentative audit; sparse stills cannot exclude unseen earlier violence or establish intention. Non-strike category a includes armed coercion and ordinary holding, not necessarily genuine escalation. Several caption-supported or low-confidence b calls require lead adjudication. Low-confidence masks must not be applied automatically.
